facts.text: The resort is in Banana Bay on the South East Peninsula of St. Kitts.
facts.excerpt: Banana Bay, South East Peninsula, St. Kitts, Saint Kitts and Nevis

facts.text: Rooms, suites and villas have floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the sea and the neighboring island of Nevis.
facts.excerpt: Our spacious contemporary designed guestrooms, suites and villas offer expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning views of the sea and neighboring island of Nevis

facts.text: Plunge Pool Rooftop suites have a private plunge pool on a rooftop sun deck.
facts.excerpt: Revel in this well-appointed 725-square-foot suite boasting one king bed and a 615-square-foot sun deck with private plunge pool.

facts.text: The One Bedroom Bi-Level Villa is a private two-story villa with a rooftop swimming pool, a fully stocked kitchen and laundry facilities.
facts.excerpt: This private two-story villa features 2,300 square feet of space with floor-to-ceiling windows, a rooftop swimming pool, and 2,165 square feet of deck space. This villa also offers a fully stocked kitchen and laundry facilities.

facts.text: The Three Bedroom Presidential Villa has a game room and a private infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Features one bedroom with two queen beds, two bedrooms with a king bed in each, a game room, private infinity pool and spacious terraces.

facts.text: The architecture of Great House restaurant reflects the grand houses that once stood at the center of each estate on St. Kitts.
facts.excerpt: The architecture of Great House restaurant reflects the grandeur of the houses that once stood at the center of each estate on St. Kitts.

facts.text: Fisherman's Village offers over-the-water dining with island-inspired cuisine in a casual atmosphere.
facts.excerpt: At Fisherman’s Village, dine over-the-water with island-inspired cuisine in a casual atmosphere with ocean views

facts.text: Stone Barn fuses Peruvian and Japanese cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Our Stone Barn offers an elevated dining experience where Peruvian and Japanese cuisine are fused for a unique gastronomic journey.

facts.text: Destination Dining includes dining barefoot on the beach in the evening.
facts.excerpt: From dining barefoot on St. Kitts beach under the starlit skies with Starlight Dining to savoring culinary inspirations at our Rampart Waterfall Cabana Dining

facts.text: Sugar Mill Spa & Sanctuary has a yoga and meditation room inside a former sugar mill.
facts.excerpt: Sugar Mill Spa & Sanctuary has a yoga and meditation room inside a former sugar mill.

facts.text: Island Fort by Camp Hyatt is a complimentary kids club for children ages 3 to 12.
facts.excerpt: Island Fort by Camp Hyatt offers a complimentary haven for little guests ages 3 to 12 at Park Hyatt St. Kitts.

facts.text: The resort has two pools, one of them adults-only.
facts.excerpt: there are two pools on the property; one of them is adults-only

facts.text: The resort fee covers non-motorized watersports including kayaking, paddle boarding and snorkeling.
facts.excerpt: Non-motorized watersports (kayaking, paddle boarding & snorkeling)

facts.text: A rum tasting class is offered with advance reservation.
facts.excerpt: Rum tasting class (advance reservation required)

facts.text: A daily resort fee applies to each room.
facts.excerpt: A daily resort fee of $60.00 (subject to change) is applied to each room of your stay

facts.text: Water taxi transportation to and from Nevis is available.
facts.excerpt: Water taxi transportation to and from Nevis is readily available.

facts.text: The hotel is cash-free and accepts only cards and contactless payment.
facts.excerpt: It is a cash-free environment.

facts.text: Park Hyatt St. Kitts is a Green Key Certified hotel.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt St. Kitts is proud to be a Green Key Certified hotel.

facts.text: The resort is pet-friendly for up to one dog or cat per room.
facts.excerpt: is a pet-friendly resort for up to one dog or cat per room

facts.text: The resort has a pickleball court with mountain views.
facts.excerpt: Play against a backdrop of beautiful mountain views at our pickleball court at Park Hyatt St. Kitts.
